scope: First 5 months of a Geometry course

coreSkills: Identify and name points, lines, planes
exampleProblems: Name the vertex of angle ABC
Identify a pair of parallel lines in a diagram
Is this angle acute or obtuse?

coreSkills: Use linear pairs to find missing angles
exampleProblems: If two lines intersect and one angle is 40°, find the other three
Two angles are supplementary; one is 2x, the other 3x. Find x.

coreSkills: Identify angle pairs when a transversal cuts parallel lines
Use congruence/supplement to find missing angles
exampleProblems: Given parallel lines and a transversal, find all angle measures
Prove two lines are parallel using angle relationships

coreSkills: Find missing interior or exterior angles
Apply base angles of isosceles triangles
exampleProblems: Find the third angle given two angles
In an isosceles triangle with vertex angle 80°, find base angles

coreSkills: Mark diagrams and write congruence statements
exampleProblems: Given two sides and included angle, name the congruence theorem
Determine if triangles are congruent and state the shortcut

coreSkills: Set up and solve proportions from similar figures
exampleProblems: Prove two triangles similar by AA
Find a missing side using a proportion

coreSkills: Find slope and use it for parallel/perpendicular lines
exampleProblems: Find the slope of a line perpendicular to y = 2x + 3
Find area of a triangle with base 10 and height 6
Find area of a trapezoid with bases 8 and 12, height 5
